text: upekkhe 7 anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci . papañcasaññā itarītarā narā papañcayantā upayanti saññino manomayaṃ gehasitañca sabbaṃ panujja nekkhammasitaṃ hi 8 iriyati 9 . evaṃ mano chassu yadā subhāvito phuṭṭhassa cittaṃ na vikampate kvaci te rāgadosaṃ 10 hi 8 abhibhuyya bhikkhavo bhavatha jātimaraṇassa pāragāti . paṭhamaṃ . [131] atha kho āyasmā mālukyaputto ātāpī pahitatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami .pe. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mālukyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato
